Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner inverted the conclusion despite correct data. After confirming that Roberto Rossellini (director of The Machine to Kill Bad People) died in 1977 and Giuliano Carnimeo (director of Poker in Bed) died in 2016, the Planner wrongly stated that Poker in Bed has the director who died earlier and even misattributed Rossellini’s death date to Poker in Bed. The correct answer should have been The Machine to Kill Bad People.
